description: ROADMAP item 158. Whether a composed phrase is shaped like something a reader can be handed. The prompt orders these phrases used VERBATIM, so nothing stands between the composer and the reader: on 2026-09-20 and 09-21 a join artefact reached two published Overviews as "much the same through Thursday, with , and showers ...". A golden vector could not catch that, because export_vectors.py computes each expected by calling the code it is pinning. This one can, because its answer is a claim about SHAPE that is true independently of what any composer produced. The passing cases matter as much as the failing ones: a false positive drops a true sentence from a live forecast.
